cues.text:
早上好呀  
zǎo shang hǎo ya  
Good morning!

现在是早上7点半  
xiàn zài shì zǎo shang 7 diǎn bàn  
It’s 7:30 in the morning right now.

天还没有完全亮  
tiān hái méi yǒu wán quán liàng  
The sky isn’t fully bright yet.

阿姨又要去菜市场了  
ā yí yòu yào qù cài shì chǎng le  
Auntie is going to the market again.

因为去菜市场的人  
yīn wèi qù cài shì chǎng de rén  
Because most people who go to the market

大多都是阿姨这个年龄的人  
dà duō dōu shì ā yí zhè ge nián líng de rén  
Most of the people are around Auntie’s age.

年轻人很少会去菜市场的  
nián qīng rén hěn shǎo huì qù cài shì chǎng de  
Young people rarely go to the market.

现在呢  
xiàn zài ne  
Now,

我要骑一个这个电动的小自行车  
wǒ yào qí yí gè zhè ge diàn dòng de xiǎo zì xíng chē  
I’m going to ride this small electric bicycle.

去菜市场  
qù cài shì chǎng  
Go to the market.

因为走路的话大概要半个小时才能到  
yīn wèi zǒu lù de huà dà gāo yào bàn ge xiǎo shí cái néng dào  
If you walk, it takes about half an hour to get there.

那里  
nà lǐ  
There.

骑电动的自行车会比较快  
qí diàn dòng de zì xíng chē huì bǐ jiào kuài  
Riding an electric bicycle is faster.

这个是一个共享的  
zhè ge shì yí gè gòng xiǎng de  
This is a shared one.

在我们这里大街上随处可见  
zài wǒ men zhè lǐ dà jiē shàng suí chù kě jiàn  
It’s commonly seen on the streets here.

你只需要用APP扫这个二维码  
nǐ zhī xū yòng APP sǎo zhè ge èr wéi mǎ  
You just need to use the app to scan this QR code.

车就能打开了  
chē jiù néng dǎ kāi le  
The bike will unlock.

好啦!它现在开始启动啦  
hǎo la! tā xiàn zài kāi shǐ qǐ dòng la  
Alright! It’s starting now.

是不是非常方便  
shì bú shì fēi cháng fāng biàn  
Isn’t it very convenient?

看这个屏幕上会给你显示剩余电量  
kàn zhè ge píng mù shàng huì gěi nǐ xiǎn shì shèng yú diàn liàng  
Look, the screen will show you the remaining battery.

现在还有91%  
xiàn zài hái yǒu 91%  
Now it's still 91%.

完全足够了  
wán quán zú gòu le  
It’s totally enough.

可以行驶66公里  
kě yǐ xíng shǐ 66 gōng lǐ  
It can travel 66 kilometers.

走吧！  
zǒu ba!  
Let’s go!

啊对  
ā duì  
Oh

好像忘了一件事  
hǎo xiàng wàng le yī jiàn shì  
I seem to have forgotten something.

忘戴头盔了  
wàng dài tóu kuī le  
I forgot to wear the helmet.

这个东西叫做头盔  
zhè ge dōng xī jiào zuò tóu kuī  
This thing is called a helmet.

这里还有一根绳子跟它连在一起的  
zhè lǐ hái yǒu yī gēn shéng zi gēn tā lián zài yī qǐ de  
There is also a string attached to it.

防止它丢失或者被人偷走  
fáng zhǐ tā diū shī huò zhě bèi rén tōu zǒu  
To prevent it from being lost or stolen.

好啦,现在已经到目的地了  
hǎo la, xiàn zài yǐ jīng dào mù dì dì le  
Alright, we have arrived at the destination.

然后我需要把电动车停在这个地方  
rán hòu wǒ xū yào bǎ diàn dòng chē tíng zài zhè ge dì fāng  
Then I need to park the electric bike here.

这是统一放电动车的地方  
zhè shì tǒng yī fàng diàn dòng chē de dì fāng  
This is the designated place for electric bikes.

看到了吗  
kàn dào le ma  
Did you see it?

这里专门画了一条线  
zhè lǐ zhuān mén huà le yì tiáo xiàn  
A line has been drawn here specifically.

共享电动车必须得停在这个地方  
gòng xiǎng diàn dòng chē bì xū děi tíng zài zhè ge dì fāng  
Shared electric bikes must be parked here.

不能随便到处乱停  
bù néng suí biàn dào chù luàn tíng  
They can’t be parked carelessly anywhere.

然后  
rán hòu  
Then

我还是需要扫这个二维码来关锁  
wǒ hái shì xū yào sǎo zhè ge èr wéi mǎ lái guān suǒ  
I still need to scan this QR code to lock it.

刚才我骑了24分钟  
gāng cái wǒ qí le 24 fēn zhōng  
I just rode for 24 minutes.

花了4块钱  
huā le 4 kuài qián  
I spent 4 yuan.

你觉得是便宜还是贵呢？ 
nǐ jué de shì pián yi hái shì guì ne  
Do you think it's cheap or expensive?

这里有一个卖树苗的摊子  
zhè lǐ yǒu yí gè mài shù miáo de tān zi  
Here is a stall selling saplings.

上面有每棵树苗的名字  
shàng miàn yǒu měi kē shù miáo de míng zì  
There are names of each sapling above.

请问这个是什么花啊  
qǐng wèn zhè ge shì shén me huā a  
Excuse me, what flower is this?

做粑粑的糯米花  
zuò bā bā de nuò mǐ huā  
It’s glutinous rice flower for making rice cakes.

糯米花  
nuò mǐ huā  
Glutinous rice flower.

粑粑花  
bā bā huā  
Rice cake flower.

这个是不是紫荆花?  
zhè ge shì bú shì zǐ jīng huā?  
Is this a redbud flower?

不是,玉荷花  
bú shì, yù hé huā  
No, it’s a YuHe flower.

玉荷花  
yù hé huā  
YuHe flower.

这个呢?  
zhè ge ne?  
What about this one?

苦刺花  
kǔ cì huā  
KuCi flower.

这个是金雀花对吧  
zhè ge shì jīn què huā duì ba  
This is a broomrape flower, right?

对  
duì  
Yes.

然后这个是香椿芽?  
rán hòu zhè ge shì xiāng chūn yá?  
And this one is an Chinese toon sprout?

不是  
bú shì  
No.

不是香椿?  
bú shì xiāng chūn?  
Isn't it Chinese toon?

是刺苞菜  
shì cì bāo cài  
It’s CiBaoCai.

长得好像香椿啊  
zhǎng de hǎo xiàng xiāng chūn a  
It looks a lot like Chinese toon.

这些拿来怎么吃?  
zhè xiē ná lái zěn me chī?  
How do you eat these?

炒了吃,煮了吃  
chǎo le chī, zhǔ le chī  
Stir-fried or boiled.

凉拌了吃  
liáng bàn le chī  
as a salad.

你想怎么吃就怎么吃  
nǐ xiǎng zěn me chī jiù zěn me chī  
You can eat it however you want.

所有这些花都可以拿来炒？  
suǒ yǒu zhè xiē huā dōu kě yǐ ná lái chǎo?  
Can all these flowers be stir-fried?

可以炒  
kě yǐ chǎo  
Yes, they can be stir-fried.

好有趣啊  
hǎo yǒu qù a  
How interesting!

哇又是花  
wā yòu shì huā  
Wow, more flowers!

各种花  
gè zhǒng huā  
Various flowers.

这个花看起来好特别啊  
zhè ge huā kàn qǐ lái hǎo tè bié a  
This flower looks so special!

这花是煎粑粑吃的  
 zhè huā shì jiān bā bā chī de  
Ah, this flower is for frying rice cakes.

做粑粑吃的  
zuò bā bā chī de  
It's used to make rice cakes.

就是做饼吃的,是吗?  
jiù shì zuò bǐng chī de, shì ma?  
So it’s used to make cakes, right?

嗯，煎粑粑  
èn, jiān bā bā  
Yes, frying rice cakes.

还有可以  
hái yǒu kě yǐ  
And it can also be used for...

泡水喝,还可以染发  
pào shuǐ hē, hái kě yǐ rǎn fà  
soak it in water to drink, and it can also be used to dye hair.

染发  
rǎn fà  
Dyeing hair.

染出来会是什么颜色  
rǎn chū lái huì shì shén me yán sè  
What color will it be dyed?

黄色的  
huáng sè de  
yellow.

黄色的  
huáng sè de  
Yellow.

哇  
wā  
Wow.

好神奇啊  
hǎo shén qí a  
So magical!

这花  
zhè huā  
This flower...

把它拿来用水煮  
bǎ tā ná lái yòng shuǐ zhǔ  
Boil it in water...

就会是黄色的水  
jiù huì shì huáng sè de shuǐ  
And the water will turn yellow.

用那些水来泡米  
yòng nà xiē shuǐ lái pào mǐ  
Use that water to soak rice.

泡了和米一起煮就成黄色的  
pào le hé mǐ yī qǐ zhǔ jiù chéng huáng sè de  
Cook it with the rice and it turns yellow.

染烫花  
rǎn tàng huā  
Colouring and Perming flower.

染烫花  
rǎn tàng huā  
Colouring and Perming flower.

好神奇啊  
hǎo shén qí a  
So amazing!

那这个吃起来会是什么味道？  
nà zhè ge chī qǐ lái huì shì shén me wèi dào?  
So what does this taste like?

什么？  
shén me?  
What?

香的味道  
xiāng de wèi dào  
fragrant taste.

还可以泡水喝  
hái kě yǐ pào shuǐ hē  
You can also soak it in water and drink it.

什么功效  
shén me gōng xiào  
What are its benefits?

这治什么的  
zhè zhì shén me de  
What does it treat?

就是清火的是吧  
jiù shì qīng huǒ de shì ba  
It helps to reduce internal heat, right?

对，清火的  
duì, qīng huǒ de  
Yes, it's for clearing heat.

好神奇。这叫什么名字啊？  
hǎo shén qí. zhè jiào shén me míng zì a?  
That’s amazing. What’s it called?

我们在农村里是叫染烫花  
wǒ men zài nóng cūn lǐ shì jiào rǎn tàng huā  
In the countryside, we call it "Colouring and Perming flower.".

染烫花哦  
rǎn tàng huā ó  
Colouring and Perming flower, oh.

太有趣了这个  
tài yǒu qù le zhè ge  
This is so interesting.

这个是金雀花  
zhè ge shì jīn què huā  
This is golden bird flower.

金雀花  
jīn què huā  
Golden bird flower.

我们这是本地的  
wǒ men zhè shì běn dì de  
This is local to our area.

我们这是甜的啊  
wǒ men zhè shì tián de a  
Ours is sweet.

这个吃起来是甜的哎  
zhè ge chī qǐ lái shì tián de a  
This tastes sweet.

这可以吃啊  
 zhè kě yǐ chī a  
Oh, this is edible?

尝一下是吧  
cháng yī xià shì ba  
I’ll give it a try then?

是甜的啊  
shì tián de a  
It is sweet!

真的是甜的  
zhēn de shì tián de  
It really is sweet.

真的是一种很天然的那种甜味  
zhēn de shì yī zhǒng hěn tiān rán de nà zhǒng tián wèi  
It’s a very natural kind of sweetness.

太神奇了这个  
tài shén qí le zhè ge  
This is so amazing!

谢谢阿姨啊  
xiè xiè ā yí a  
Thank you, auntie!

谢谢，谢谢你  
xiè xiè xiè xiè nǐ  
Thanks, thank you so much!

不用谢  
bú yòng xiè  
You’re welcome.

这个看起来像萝卜  
zhè ge kàn qǐ lái xiàng luó bo  
This looks like a radish.

这个是什么呀?请问  
zhè ge shì shén me a? qǐng wèn  
What is this, may I ask?

茴香  
huí xiāng  
Fennel.

茴香  
huí xiāng  
Fennel.

这是茴香的根对吧？  
zhè shì huí xiāng de gēn duì ba?  
This is the root of fennel, right?

对啊  
duì a  
Yes.

茴香的根怎么吃呢？  
huí xiāng de gēn zěn me chī ne?  
How do you eat fennel root?

煮排骨  
zhǔ pái gǔ  
Boil it with pork ribs.

煮排骨  
zhǔ pái gǔ  
Boil it with ribs.

是香的吗  
shì xiāng de ma  
Does it smell good?

香的。又香又甜  
xiāng de. yòu xiāng yòu tián  
Yes, it's aromatic. Fragrant and sweet.

又香又甜哇  
yòu xiāng yòu tián wa  
Fragrant and sweet—wow!

好神奇啊  
hǎo shén qí a  
So magical.

你们这里好多东西我们都没有见过  
nǐ men zhè lǐ hǎo duō dōng xī wǒ men dōu méi yǒu jiàn guò  
There are so many things here we’ve never seen before!

感觉今天人不是特别多  
gǎn jué jīn tiān rén bù shì tè bié duō  
It feels like there aren’t many people today.

可能是今天是周六吧  
kě néng shì jīn tiān shì zhōu liù ba  
Maybe because today is Saturday.

大家可能还在睡懒觉  
dà jiā kě néng hái zài shuì lǎn jiào  
Maybe people are still sleeping in.

这鸡蛋看起来好新鲜  
zhè jī dàn kàn qǐ lái hǎo xīn xiān  
These eggs look so fresh.

你们知道这个是什么吗？  
nǐ men zhī dào zhè ge shì shén me ma?  
Do you guys know what this is?

这个是皮蛋对不对  
zhè ge shì pí dàn duì bù duì  
This is century egg, right?

蘑菇  
mó gū  
Mushrooms.

哇塞！好多东西都没有见过哦  
wa sāi! hǎo duō dōng xī dōu méi yǒu jiàn guò ó  
Wow! So many things I’ve never seen before!

这个都是野生的  
zhè ge dōu shì yě shēng de  
These are all wild.

都是野生的  
dōu shì yě shēng de  
All wild.

对啊！在山后呀  
duì a! zài shān hòu ya  
Yes! From behind the mountain.

哇！都没有见过  
wa! dōu méi yǒu jiàn guò  
Wow! Never seen any of these.

这个是金银花吧？  
zhè ge shì jīn yín huā ba?  
Is this honeysuckle?

对啊  
duì a  
Yeah.

怎么吃？  
zěn me chī?  
How do you eat it?

这个泡水喝呀  
zhè ge pào shuǐ hē ya  
Soak it in water and drink it.

不能拿来烧菜吗？  
bù néng ná lái shāo cài ma?  
Can’t you cook with it?

这个是桑葚的花吧  
zhè ge shì sāng shèn de huā ba  
This is mulberry flower, right?

对吧？对  
duì ba duì  
Yeah, yeah.

怎么吃啊这个  
zěn me chī a zhè ge  
How do you eat this?

这个炒（来）吃呀  
zhè ge chǎo (lái) chī ya  
This one you stir-fry.

炒菜啊  
chǎo cài a  
Stir-fry it.

对  
duì  
Right.

这个是某种植物的芽吧  
zhè ge shì mǒu zhǒng zhí wù de yá ba  
This looks like the sprout of some plant.

这个也是一种花  
zhè ge yě shì yī zhǒng huā  
This is also a kind of flower.

年轻人不知道  
nián qīng rén bù zhī dào  
Young people don’t know this.

还没有开的花  
hái méi yǒu kāi de huā  
A flower that hasn’t bloomed yet.

你是外地人  
nǐ shì wài dì rén  
You're not local.

我来这里旅游的  
wǒ lái zhè lǐ lǚ yóu de  
I’m here traveling.

没见过，没见过  
méi jiàn guò, méi jiàn guò  
Never seen it, never seen it.

这个是卖蜂蜜的  
zhè ge shì mài fēng mì de  
This is a honey vendor.

哎，不对  
āi, bú duì  
Ah, no, that’s not right.

卖芝麻油的  
mài zhī ma yóu de  
He is selling sesame oil.

这是现场榨的芝麻油  
zhè shì xiàn zhà de zhī ma yóu  
This is freshly pressed sesame oil.

现榨现卖  
xiàn zhà xiàn mài  
Pressed and sold on the spot.

芝麻油，芝麻酱  
zhī ma yóu, zhī ma jiàng  
Sesame oil, sesame paste.

非常新鲜  
fēi cháng xīn xiān  
Very fresh.

香味特别好  
xiāng wèi tè bié hǎo  
The aroma is especially good.

用来凉拌菜  
yòng lái liáng bàn cài  
Use it in cold dishes.

米线，面条  
mǐ xiàn, miàn tiáo  
Rice noodles, regular noodles.

包饺子。现榨现卖  
bāo jiǎo zi. xiàn zhà xiàn mài  
For dumplings. Pressed and sold on the spot.

芝麻油，芝麻酱  
zhī ma yóu, zhī ma jiàng  
Sesame oil, sesame paste.

非常新鲜  
fēi cháng xīn xiān  
Very fresh.

香味特别好  
xiāng wèi tè bié hǎo  
The aroma is especially good.

用来擦烧烤  
yòng lái cā shāo kǎo  
Brush it on barbecue

做蘸水、凉拌菜，都非常香  
zuò zhàn shuǐ, liáng bàn cài, dōu fēi cháng xiāng  
For dipping sauce or cold dishes — very fragrant.

冷的、热的都可以食用  
lěng de, rè de dōu kě yǐ shí yòng  
Good for both hot and cold dishes.

芝麻油，芝麻酱  
zhī ma yóu, zhī ma jiàng  
Sesame oil, sesame paste.

非常新鲜  
fēi cháng xīn xiān  
Very fresh.

卖鱼的摊子  
mài yú de tān zi  
A stall that sells fish.

这个鱼闻起来好香啊  
zhè ge yú wén qǐ lái hǎo xiāng a  
This fish smells amazing!

闻起来好香，好想吃  
wén qǐ lái hǎo xiāng, hǎo xiǎng chī  
Smells so good, really want to eat it.

新鲜的豆腐  
xīn xiān de dòu fu  
Fresh tofu.

蓝莓  
lán méi  
Blueberries.

哇  
wā  
Wow.

这个蓝莓好大颗呀  
zhè ge lán méi hǎo dà kē ya  
These blueberries are so big!

好大颗，你看  
hǎo dà kē, nǐ kàn  
So big! Look!

比我的手指头还大  
bǐ wǒ de shǒu zhǐ tóu hái dà  
Bigger than my fingertip!

这里有一个鲜花店  
zhè lǐ yǒu yī gè xiān huā diàn  
There’s a flower shop here.

这个是菊花  
zhè ge shì jú huā  
These are chrysanthemums.

菊花在中国是用来祭奠逝去的人的  
jú huā zài zhōng guó shì yòng lái jì diàn shì qù de rén de  
In China, chrysanthemums are used to mourn the deceased.

就是死人  
jiù shì sǐ rén  
people who have passed away.

嗯，所以呢  
ēn, suǒ yǐ ne  
Yeah, so...

菊花在中国  
jú huā zài zhōng guó  
Chrysanthemums in China...

我们不能当作礼物来赠送  
wǒ men bù néng dāng zuò lǐ wù lái zèng sòng  
...shouldn’t be given as gifts.

现在离清明节很近了  
xiàn zài lí qīng míng jié hěn jìn le  
It’s almost Qingming Festival now.

如果你想要去坟墓  
rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng yào qù fén mù  
If you want to visit a grave...

去墓地看望你逝去的亲人或者朋友  
qù mù dì kàn wàng nǐ shì qù de qīn rén huò zhě péng yǒu  
To visit deceased family or friends at the cemetery...

你就可以带上一束这样子的菊花
